Arrived at response location. OPSM had texted prior to our arrival, person of interest has left the scene and made his way up Queen Street. Description: male, dark skin, African, wearing all black. No photos of the person of interest captured or retrieved.

sections.title: Afternoon / Evening Shift (14:30 – 22:30)
items: Equipment received: 5 x Keys, 2 x Swipe Cards, 2 x Vests, 1 x Ops Phone.
Response call from Specsavers Queen St regarding a male inside their store who seems to be a bit aggressive towards the staff.

Arrived at Specsavers Queen St, person of interest has already left the premises. Description: black hat, black shorts, black jacket, black glasses. Informed store manager we will keep an eye out for the male individual whilst on patrols, standing by outside Specsavers in case the person of interest decides to return.
Response call from Jo & Joe's Fort St regarding a male vaping inside their store, asked for assistance in removing him from the premises.
Arrived at Jo & Joe's, manager informed us he has already left but is still within the area inside Wilson carpark on Fort St.

Spotted male outside Wilson carpark, informed him not to go back into Jo & Joe's, he complied with our orders, no issues to report. Standing by maintaining presence as well as on the lookout for any problematic issues or vagrants within the area.
Leaving standby area with no issues that have occurred, commencing patrols.
Arrived at Commercial Bay, welfare check on McDonald's Britomart, all clear, no issues to report.
Commercial Bay sweep complete, all clear, no issues to report. Alpha Route commencing from Commercial Bay.

Arrived at St Patricks Sq Cathedral.

Standing by on the lookout for any problematic issues as well as any nearby response calls.
Response call from Recycle Boutique regarding a male who has stood outside their store cussing at staff members and throwing food at their store, heading to response call.

Arrived at Recycle Boutique, manager informed us he has already left the premises and was last seen heading towards Queen St. Footage received and it is the same person of interest from Jo & Joe's. Informed manager we will have a chat with him once we have intercepted him whilst on patrols.

Commencing a full sweep of Fort St down to Gore St, welfare checks on stores whilst doing so.
Arrived at Gore St, welfare checks on stores complete as well as full sweep, all clear, no issues to report. Beta Route complete.
Arrived at the bottom of Federal St, commencing Charlie Route.
St Patricks Sq sweep complete, no issues to report.

Arrived at Celines, informed vagrants they had to vacate somewhere else, they complied with our orders, no issues to report. Standing by.

Response call from McDonald's Queen St regarding a male sleeping inside their store, asked for assistance in removing the male from the store.

Arrived at McDonald's Queen St, informed male he had to depart the premises, he complied with our orders and has left. Standing by outside McDonald's Queen St in case the person of interest decides to return. Ending Echo Route.
Leaving standby area, no issues to report and person of interest has not returned.

Break over, standing by HQ awaiting night shift as well as being vigilant to any response calls that we may receive.
Afternoon shift complete, handover to night shift. Auror reports have been made.
